name: interrupt-clears-pending-permission-without-answering
description: While the agent waits on a permission request, the person interrupts the turn. The interrupt is sent, the pending request is cleared at once, and no permission answer (allow or deny) is sent for it.
reason: Interrupting cancels the turn the request belongs to; the adapter cancels the agent's side of it. A banner left behind would invite a press that answers nothing (or, after a second press, 'approves' a cancelled destructive action).
source: Epic #92 rule 'interrupt clears pending permission'; docs/harnesses.md 'A request left hanging when the turn ends or you interrupt is cancelled automatically'; DESIGN.md v2.0 ACPAdapter 'unanswered requests are cancelled on stop/interrupt'; AppState.interruptClaude

script.reason: An ordinary (not destructive) request is waiting.
The person stops the turn instead of answering.

transcript.text: The agent wants to: Edit — main.swift. Press ✕ to allow or ○ to deny.
